notes.title: Versus Squad 1.32 is now live on Steam!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

[list]
 [*]New languages added! Versus Squad is now available in French and Polish. Thanks to [b]Noodle Master[/b] for translating the whole game into Polish!

 [*]Every boss will now always drop money when killed

 [*]Regular zombies will drop 30% more money in the first 30 minutes, and 20% more in the first hour of a game

 [*]Added a new hardcore difficulty level: Ultra Violence Difficulty. Faster enemy spawning, more money drops and extra Xp, enemies do 50% more damage. This is for experienced players who want to score higher with shorter games but with more chance to die sooner as well. Be warned: Ultra is 50% more difficult than 'Hard' difficulty, but also gives 50% more Xp!

 [*]Clamped maximum damage you can receive in one time, even in highest difficulty you won't die from a single hit if your health was >50%.

 [*]In unlimited ammo mode, all weapons picked up will have a full ammo clip, there's no chance of a random ammo amount

Coop:

 [*]Death Clock shows for non-host players (red shield around player during 30 seconds of invulnerability)

 [*]The grenade counter now shows correctly if non-host players have more than 15 grenades (Tactical Perk)

 [*]Skip build phase for gamepad: to prevent accidental left trigger grenade explosion from skipping build phase for everyone else, you now need to hold down the left trigger for 2 seconds to skip the build phase

 [*]Optimizations! Rendering speed increased by almost 20% allowing for more simultaneous barricades and enemies.

[/list]

notes.title: Weapon Improvements and More
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Did a quick update for Versus Squad to add some requests:

[list]
[*]Weapons are now more balanced:

M4A1: +30% damage
UZI, USP: +15%
Nailgun: +10%
Famas, M1919:  +8%
KEDR: +10%
MGL explosions: +20% (useful for boss killing)

[*]Online Coop:

For hosts, added a popup warning if not all players are ready to start the next wave if you're pressing Space to skip the build phase.
(You can press Space again to force start the next round if you really don't want to wait for the other players)
This will make it less likely that a host starts a new wave while other players are still building. Remember you can hit Space to show you're ready to play

[*]Fixed Radial command menu for gamepads/controllers (Click down the Right Thumbstick to send commands such as: Boss Here!, Medkit Here!, Help! etc.)

[*]Reduced online bandwidth requirements by about 7.5%

[*]From today, new leaderboard entries will also show the map on which the game was played. If you select the leaderboard entry or hover the mouse cursor over a new score, it will show the map name

[*]Enemies now drop 15% extra coins during first 30 minutes of a game

[/list]

notes.title: Manual Repair Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

A quick update to Versus Squad to add manual repairing. Many people have asked for this option to prevent you from accidentally spending money on repairs.

To enable Manual Repairing: in the game options go to:

[b]Options -> Control -> Weapons/Repair/Mouse -> Manual Repair On/Off[/b]

Then use the E key to repair the nearest object during build phases.

For gamepad/controller users:

[b]Options-> Controller -> Weapons/Repair/Movement -> Manual Repair On/Off[/b]

and then use the A button to repair

I'm going to add more of your requests in the next update! Thanks for the continued forum suggestions!

notes.title: Versus v1.26 now live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

VERSUS SQUAD has updated to version 1.26. 

Thanks to everyone who has come up with these gameplay suggestions and ideas!

To recap here are all the changes made since version 1.25:

[list]
[*]Simplified Chinese version is available now :)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26641405/c5f974e4e2d4e3533029c293cab96525c766f689.jpg[/img]

[*][b]Added a FRAG-12 shotgun![/b] 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26641405/4d813da57a85a2a5bb120af92a2c6722110b6af3.jpg[/img]

The Saiga-12 shotgun loaded with 30 explosive FRAG-12 shells will shred any enemy to pieces. The Saiga does take longer to reload, so when using this new weapon you should prioritize the faster reload perks. Apart from its reload time, this will probably become one of the favorite weapons :)

[*]Added the associated FRAG-12 achievement (Easy-Medium difficulty).

[*]You can now pickup/sell damaged objects as well. For example if a sentry gun is 25% damaged, you will get back 75% of its value when you remove it from the map.

[*]Added a new option: Player kicking On/Off in the game's 'Control Options' section. If you're out of grenades and wish to keep moving instead of slowing down and kick, you can now turn kicking Off.

[*]Strategic Perk mode now shows the number of strategic perk picks you have and how many you have left to pick.

[*]New Random powerup choice in Random Perk Mode. When playing in Random Perk mode you will now always get a 6th 'Get a Random Powerup' option in case you don't like any listed perks or when you've gotten all perks. This will drop a random powerup a few meters away from you. In online coop you can also let another player pick up this powerup.

[*]'Static Attack' Bosses like the Rotor, Mortar and M61 Gatling Bosses will try not to linger just outside the edges of the map anymore. 

[*]Added 'Host Dominion' in on-line coop: when a player leaves, the host will get access to that player's objects so you can remove them if needed.

[*]'Player has joined the lobby' and 'Player has joined the game' messages will now be in your set language and not in the language set by the player who's joining.

[*]Physics collisions with flares, exploded gas canisters, empty weapon magazines etc. have been removed since they sometimes blocked the player.

[*]Easy Difficulty now has 20% less damage done to the player and 10% less chance of enemies running.

[*]10% extra coin drops in the first 30 minutes of a game.

[*]Added armor-based Boss XP: Since bosses will increase their armor up to 2.5X their original during the game, you will now get up to 2.5X their XP per kill, allowing you to move up the leaderboard faster.

notes.title: Versus v1.25 now live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Versus Squad version 1.25 should be live on Steam now. Here is a list of additions:

[b]Added a new Paintball Field map! [/b]

This map has a typical paintball field layout with several non-destructible defenses: high and low. Low defenses block enemy movement, high defenses also block projectile fire from the Gatling Gun and Rotor bosses. Remember high defenses will also block your own weapon fire, so adjust your strategy accordingly.

Added a Paintball map projectile blocking related achievement 

[b]Misc:[/b]

[list]
[*]Added an explosion countdown counter for the Mortar boss.
Also made the mortars fall to the ground a little slower giving you a little more time to avoid them.

[*]When playing on Easy difficulty, the Mortar boss will launch 20% fewer attacks.

[*]Added boss names to the boss indicators so you can prepare for which boss is incoming.

[*]Increased enemy hitbox by 10%.

[*]Fixed Tank boss tracking you when you're cloaked.

[*]Fixed flares 'going out' when Tabbing to the Statistics menu and back.

[/list]

notes.title: Versus v1.24 now live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Versus Squad version 1.24 should now be live on Steam. These are the changes/additions since version 1.22:

Thanks for all these suggestions!


[b]Added the Flamethrower weapon![/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26641405/43f0642ae451376c140f53d8b5f4b13c2812cffb.jpg[/img]

The Flamer Boss will usually drop his M2 Flamethrower when killed. Although moderately useful against bosses, this weapon can be very effective against regular enemies. Simply setting enemies on fire will kill them very quickly - there is no need to keep targeting them until they are dead. This makes the Flamethrower different from the other weapon types.

[b]Added the weapon's associated achievement "Fired Up"[/b]


[b]Building/Waves[/b]

Increased Wave build time in coop to 60 seconds to allow more repair time. (Remember you can skip the build phase with Space/Left Trigger).

Unified wave enemy numbers. Waves now ramp up from 25 enemies (instead of 50) at wave 1, 50 in wave 2, 75 wave 3, etc. To offset, there's 20% more chance of running enemies in earlier waves.


[b]Coins[/b]

Increased coin pickup time by +5 secs, plus increased coin visibility, larger font.


[b]Gameplay[/b]

Added a player grenade counter for coop. You can now see how many grenades other players have to help you to decide to share grenade pickups.

Made the grenade counter for Remote Detonator (at crosshair position) easier to read

Added a transparent melee range overlay when using melee weapons.

When picking up a Ghost powerup when you already have ghosts active, the active Ghosts will now stay on the map for the correct longer duration.

Suicide Bombers now give 500 Xp instead of 250 Xp when killed.

Added a red shield glow for Death Clock to help you see when Death Clock is active.

Boss Power powerup drop spacing. When you have Boss Power, the two powerups dropped by bosses should no longer overlap making it easier to see what they have dropped. There is also now 50% less chance of identical powerups dropping.


[b]Gamepads[/b]

Pressing B for Back when you have an item to build will now correctly cancel the build and bring you back to the inventory.

Better object placing 'snapping' for gamepad users when building.

notes.title: Versus v1.22 now live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Versus Squad version 1.22 should be live on Steam at any time. Here is a list of additions:

[b]As requested, the JackHammer has been added![/b] 

The JackHammer is an excellent medium short range weapon with rapid firepower and good reload speed. Being a heavy weapon it will slow you down a little though.

[b]Added the weapon's associated achievements:[/b]

Hammered
In a game use the Jackhammer to kill 5 Demolition Bosses

Hammer And Nail
For 20 minutes kill bosses only with a Nailgun, others only with a Jackhammer

For Hammer And Nail make sure you remember to switch to the correct weapon when killing any boss - and back again for regular enemies - otherwise your achievement time is reset ;)

[b]Misc:[/b]

Seekers now target the nearest enemies much more effectively. They will always try to target the nearest enemy and avoid targeting some enemy far across the map. This strongly reduces the chance of any wasted seekers. I've also increased their final explosion range more so that they will kill enemies even when not too close.

When playing Tactical Wave game, extra wave information is shown before each wave starts, including the maximum number of simultaneous bosses on this wave, and the current enemy armor multiplier.

[b]Weapons:[/b]

Added blowback for enemies when hit by your weaponfire

For balancing, reduced reload time for the KEDR and the Enfield A2 by just under 10%

notes.title: Weekend Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I wanted to release this quick update before the weekend, this contains some additional things requested by players:


[b]Reviving:[/b]

You now get +10% Health bonus yourself when you revive another player, giving reviving an added incentive. You'll see a '+10 HP' popup when you get this extra health.


[b]Bosses:[/b]

Added the final ramp-up of extra aggression for the Gatling Gun, Mortar, Tank and Rotor Bosses. (I've added this ramp-up in stages over the last 3 updates so that gameplay didn't suddenly change too much.)

What this means:

If there is only 1 boss (left) on the map: The above boss types may launch attacks up to 2x more often than they originally did.

With 2 or more bosses: there's no change.


To compensate, Boss 'bleed-out' speed has increased by 5% when there's only one boss left on the screen. (Just in case for those who didn't notice this: bosses just like regular enemies slowly bleed out/lose health after they've taken any type of damage). 


[b]Repairing:[/b]

Repairing is now more precise: It will only kick in if you're at the *same* barricade/sentry for a second or more. If you run past another barricade, you won't suddenly start repairing and losing money unless you stop at that barricade for a short time.


[b]Misc:[/b]

You should no longer be able to harm other players during the build phase.

New Boss direction indicator/arrow stays visible for 5 seconds longer.

Reduced bandwidth for on-line games by a further 4-5%. In total, bandwidth needed has now been reduced by about 30% since Versus first launched. Every bit helps for those who have slower connections :)

notes.title: Versus v1.21 now live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Version 1.21 is now live on Steam!

[b]Here's what has been added since version 1.19:[/b]

[list]
[*]You can now repair barricades during build phases! 
To do this, stand near a damaged barricade and repair will automatically kick in after 1 second.
Repairs cost up to 90% of the cost of the item. For example if you repair a barricade that costs 500 new and it is 50% damaged, the repair will cost 225 coins. So repairing is a bit cheaper than rebuying the item, but it takes time

Bonus: You can now also repair all types of sentry guns.

[*]Increased the size of the Battlefield map by 20% and the Campsite map by 40% for those who like Run n Gunning.

[*]Increased powerup drop rate by 10% during the first 30 minutes of a game. This will make a few achievements a little easier to hunt down.

[*]For the M61, Mortar and Flamer Bosses: Increased their attack frequency by 25% but only if they are the only boss left on the map. There is no change when there are multiple bosses active.

[*]Increased camera height by 5 meters (15 feet) so you can see more of the battlefield.

[*]Frequency of money (coins) dropped increased by 20%. You should quickly be able to pick up 1000+ coins per wave and more in waves 10+.

[*]Increased cooldown speed of regular sentry by 10%
[/list]

[b]Achievements:[/b]

[list]
[*]Added 5 new achievements: Drone Strike, Burst, Serial Kill, Massacre and Intruder.
[/list]

[b]Multiplayer:[/b]
[list]
[*]In on-line coop games, clients can now tell the host/server they are ready to begin the next wave by hitting Space or Left Trigger during a build phase. The host will see a 'READY!' indicator mark above the players who are ready.

[*]The host/server now updates 30% faster which should reduce lag (enemies and the state of the game gets updated more often)

[*]Decreased damage from the Flamethrower boss 30% and added a small delay so that you're less likely to get damaged when the flamethrower weapon is just starting up.

[*]Armor of enemies is reduced by 10% which makes enemies a little easier to kill in online games.
[/list]

notes.title: Sentry update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Versus has updated to version 1.13. You can build a new type of sentrygun! The MK19 Grenade Sentry.
This gun has a slower firing rate than the normal sentry but 5x more killing power, firing explosive grenades. It should kill any regular enemy in one hit and is very effective against bosses when in a group of 3 or more.

To allow for more sentrygun types with different weapon mounts to be added, there are some small changes:

Sentry guns can now be reloaded at any time (outside build phase), not just when they are empty. But the reload speed varies according to the type of gun. The regular sentry reloads in a second, the MK19 sentry takes 2.5 seconds to reload. Other sentry guns will have different reload speeds.

Remember when you build a sentry gun: try to place any type of 'decoy' barricade nearby (for example a barrel) so that you have less chance of a boss targeting and destroying that sentry.

Also:

Added female soundfx for the Sniper class

Fixed a bug where you could (sometimes) not buy or build if you joined a game in progress


What am I working on now/what's coming next:

Electric fences

Perk Group icons

Shotgun sentry (wide-angle fire)

A new machine gun weapon

notes.title: Patch 1.12 now live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Here's what has changed since the last update news:

The game will now save your player profile settings for all 5 classes (visual, attributes, weapons and perks). This will require you to set these up once.

This means that when set up, you can freely switch between all classes, each with your chosen weapons, perks, attributes and visual look. Especially useful for quickly putting together a team in the lobby of an on-line multiplayer game!

Added new detailed high resolution ground textures for the Prison and Campsite maps and made their default map/barricade setup easier to start building with for beginners

Optimized rendering speed by almost +10%. Most people will see a similar fps/frames per second increase.

Explosions now guaranteed to damage all nearby enemies, enemies will no longer be blocked from damage by other enemies (Note: this makes the game a little easier since explosions will kill more :)

Payload perk now gives Xp from enemies killed by the explosion

Increased targeting accuracy (enemy hit box calculation)

KSG Shotgun: 35% faster reload time

Reduced damage of the Trapper Boss by 30%

You can now build closer to the edge of the maps

Coins will now stay 'active' for pickup for 20 seconds instead of 12, making it easier not to miss any pickups

50% more chance to get 100 coin drop amount instead of a 50-coin drop

Enemies will target all types of barricades to damage them, not just barricades that block their path (for example razor wire, wood spikes)

Last week added the Combat, No Fly Zone, SemiPro, Commander, Warlord and Master achievements. So these have been playtested and are working as expected :)

notes.title: Versus v1.08 now live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

[b]Persistent Player Ranks and Perks[/b]

Version 1.08 includes the first version of persistent player leveling up! The way this works is as follows:

There are 8 player ranks, ranging from Recruit to Master. Each rank requires a balance of total kills and active playtime. Versus was already tracking total kills but from now it will also track 'active' playtime. This time will only increase while a game is in progress (and not while you're in the menu, when the game is paused, when in the building phase, or when it's game over, etc.)

Your total kills will have already been saved, and these will be taken into account.

For those interested, the required kills and active playtime for each rank is listed below.

Whenever you reach a new rank, you can select another persistent base perk. So for example when you've reached player level 5 (Captain), you can select up to 5 persistent base perks which you'll have when you start any game.

(A base perk is any perk which doesn't require another lower perk. Most perks are base perks, for example Powerup Hook, Regeneration, Endurance, etc. A perk like Snare or Heavy Armor is not a base perk and you'll still need to earn those during a game.

I'm looking into adding further player customization which unlocks with each player level.


[b]Player Classes[/b]

As requested, Player Classes now also have their own powerup skill:

Scouts: +30% projectile weapon damage during 'Speed' powerups.

Scavengers: +30% more mines during 'Minelayer' and 'Claymore' powerups.

Assaults: +30% explosion damage during 'Rage' powerups.

Medics: +30% melee weapon damage during 'Shield' powerups. (esp. useful for those players meleeing bosses)


[b]Misc.[/b]

XP Level Up sound effect changed to be a little more noticeable

Several gamepad improvements


[b]Required historic kills and active playtime for each player rank:[/b]

Recruit: Default rank

Soldier: 1000 kills + 10 mins. active playtime

Trooper: 5000 kills + 30 mins.

Veteran: 10000 kills + 60 mins.

Captain: 25000 kills + 5 hours.

Commander: 50000 kills + 10 hours.

Warlord: 100000 kills + 20 hours.

Master: 250000 kills + 50 hours.

notes.title: Versus 1.05 now live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,


Some of you have been testing this over the last two days :)


[b]Game[/b]

By popular request, you can now build between waves in Tactical Mode:

- Some enemies and bosses will now drop coins when killed. Coins can be used to buy new barricades, sentry guns, weapon stations, mines and hand grenades between waves.

- Regular enemies drop 50 coins and bosses up to 250.

- Each player can carry up to 10,000 coins at any time.

- Coins can be pulled with Powerup Hook and Snare.

- By default you will have 30 seconds to build between each wave. If you do not want to build between a wave, hit the Space bar or gamepad X button to advance to the next wave.

- You can remove damaged barricades and build new ones in their place. By hovering the crosshairs over a barricade or item, you will be able to see how many coins you will get in return when removing it. I.e: if you bought the object and it is still undamaged, you get 100% of its value back. If an object is damaged or you did not buy it, you can remove it but will not get coins in return.

A reminder: If you prefer new barricades to 'snap' into place, turn On the build helper grid in the left side menu. If you want to freely place items, turn Off the build grid.


[b]Perks[/b]

Added the Laser Guided perk. This perk is especially useful for players using gamepads since it's easier to visualize your weapon fire direction. Laser Guided also adds another 10% more projectile range. Important: when the game adds new perks, check your Auto-Perk list is still set up correctly just in case new perks have been inserted.


[b]Weapons[/b]

When switching weapons during reloading, you can now immediately fire the other weapon if it has ammo. The reload sequence will be cancelled and you no longer need to wait for the whole reload to complete before being able to fire again.


[b]Enemies[/b]

Boss armor increase is now capped. Bosses will no longer grow too strong to kill with a reasonable number of ammunition. To balance this, the boss spawn rate has increased 12.5%


[b]Misc.[/b]

You now have more control over the number of dead corpses with the 'Corpses Density' slider in the Options.

Laser Guided also adds another 10% more projectile range. Important: when the game adds new perks, check your Auto-Perk list is still set up correctly just in case new perks have been inserted.


[b]Weapons[/b]

When switching weapons during reloading, you can now immediately fire the other weapon if it has ammo. The reload sequence will be cancelled and you no longer need to wait for the whole reload to complete before being able to fire again.


[b]Enemies[/b]

Boss armor increase is now capped. Bosses will no longer grow too strong to kill with a reasonable number of ammunition. To balance this, the boss spawn rate has increased 12.5%


[b]Misc.[/b]

You now have more control over the number of dead corpses with the 'Corpses Density' slider in the Options.

notes.title: Versus version 1.01
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26641405/83b3af1aded9f8398fee2e5de6f22d72b64f3b0c.jpg[/img]


Versus updated to its first ever update version 1.01; here's a list of changes and additions made since game launch:

Thanks to everyone for the constructive feedback so far! More requested additions are coming in version 1.02


[b]On-line[/b]

You can now join in a game-in-progress both during the build-phase and the in-game phase. (Of course this means you can start an on-line game by yourself as well).


[b]Tactical Wave Mode[/b]

You can now repair structures in-between waves. Barricade outlines will show the current status of barricades near your position. Move near an object to start repairing it.
Repair speed will depend on the barricade's armor, i.e. wood barricades will repair quickly, concrete and Hesco much slower.


[b]Powerups[/b]

No Reload now instantly refills your ammo if you were reloading at the time of pickup

Hand Grenade crates now have a strong orange explosion tag/mark on them to set them visually more apart from weapon grenades

Increased powerup drop rate by 10%


[b]Bosses[/b]

Trapper Boss: has 10% slower speed, 30% less armor, 30% less melee radius. Xp gained from his kill goes from 6000 to 5000.
Demolition Boss: has 15% slower speed
M61 Boss: movement speed increased 30%
Rotor Boss: increased visibility of rocket projectiles
The M61, Rotor and Mortar bosses will attack sooner.

More boss AI changes are planned for the next update.


[b]Build Phase[/b]

Structure/Object Build Snap: If you want objects to 'snap' into place, display the Helper Grid (left icon during build phase). If you want to freely place objects, turn off the Helper Grid.

Reduced pricing for several objects. 


[b]Friendly Fire[/b]

You can now set Friendly Fire to off for on-line or local coop games (apart from low, medium and high)


[b]Player[/b]

Revival: You now get 8 seconds of invulnerability when revived instead of 5.

Increased walking backwards speed by 35%


[b]Key Mapping[/b]

on Windows, Shift and CTRL should now be correctly mappable

Middle Mouse Button and extra buttons 4 and 5 should now be mappable

Added a 'Reset Controls' option to the menu to set them back to defaults


[b]Weapons[/b]

USP: Reduced range by 15% and damage by 30%
MGL: Increased damage by 20% but reload speed increased by 30%


[b]Misc[/b]

Added Reload timer + circle at the crosshairs/cursor

Added more blood fx when shooting an enemy
